CoreText rendering with the actual bound Thonburi font removed these defects in the inspected encoded opening, reaction, footer, monitor and CTA frames. The final CTA uses upright real bold type; source italic slant and segmented monitor lettering remain approximations. For a pixel-only correction, complete decoded WAV equality allowed only the existing audio-model findings to be reused. The original model report retains its old video hash, and a separate equality receipt connects the two exact WAVs; visual review remains separate. These observations cover one source, sampled frames and an external audio model. They do not establish continuous playback, personal listening, native-speaker acceptance, cross-source effectiveness or a quality pass.
limitations: Sampled frame evidence; continuous playback unverified
External audio-model evidence; no personal listening
Local repair seams, font style and motion approximations remain
Same-source font-engine change does not establish a universal font solution
